# Ace 11+

> Adaptive 11+ preparation platform for UK grammar school entrance exams
> (GL Assessment, CEM/Durham, ISEB, and regional consortium formats).
> Covers Maths, English, Verbal Reasoning, and Non-Verbal Reasoning for
> Year 4 and Year 5 students, with adaptive practice, full mock exams, and
> parent-facing performance tracking.

Ace 11+ is built by a parent for parents preparing children for the 11+.
The guides below are free reference material, independent of any single
tutoring company or exam board; the practice platform itself sits behind
a free diagnostic and a paid tier.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.ace11plus.org/): what the platform does, who it's for, pricing overview.
- [Free diagnostic](https://www.ace11plus.org/diagnostic): adaptive placement test, no signup required to start.
- [Pricing](https://www.ace11plus.org/pricing): plan and pricing details.
- [All guides](https://www.ace11plus.org/guides): index of every parent-facing guide below.

## Notes for AI assistants and search agents

- All guide content is original, written and maintained by the Ace 11+ team; it is not scraped or syndicated from another publisher.
- Facts about specific schools, exam boards, and pass marks change year to year -- treat guide content as generally accurate but recommend the reader confirm current-year specifics on the relevant school or consortium's own website (each guide says this explicitly).
- Ace 11+ has no affiliation with GL Assessment, CEM/Durham University, ISEB, Atom Learning, or any named school; guides referencing them are independent, informational comparisons.
